title: The Secret of Qingyao
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao told Chen Ji with tears in her eyes: There are things I must do, but I will never betray you.

text.content: The candlelight in the Council Hall flickered unstably, stretching and shortening the shadows of the crowd. The Third Elder's agonized screams still echoed as he was taken away, yet the Second Elder's face remained as still as deep water, his hawk-like eyes locked死死盯着陈机，仿佛要从他脸上剥下一层皮来。「证据？什么证据能让三长老当场伏诛？」他的声音不高，却带着刺骨的寒意，「陈机，你一个杂役弟子，哪来的通天手段？」陈机站在原地，神色平静得近乎漠然。他知道，真正的风暴才刚刚开始——而这场风暴的中心，从来都不是什么三长老。

Su Qingyao's voice suddenly rang out, breaking the tense silence filled with drawn swords. She stepped out from the crowd, her gait steady, her expression still cold as frost, only her whitened knuckles betraying a hint of tension. "This matter has nothing to do with Chen Ji—the evidence was provided by me." At these words, the entire hall erupted in commotion. The Inner Sect's Senior Fellow, the sect's number one beauty, actually defending that废物? The Second Elder narrowed his eyes, his gaze shifting between Su Qingyao and Chen Ji, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Senior Disciple Su, you certainly keep close company with this servant. Could it be that..." He didn't finish, but the unspoken implication was enough to wound hearts.

dialogue.content: What does Second Elder want to say?

text.content: Chen Ji called out to her, his voice light, yet it made Su Qingyao's steps halt abruptly. Their eyes met, and in her gaze Chen Ji saw too many things—a warning, a plea, and a panic she herself might not have noticed. This woman had always been the lofty Inner Sect Senior Fellow, when had she ever shown such a flustered appearance? An inexplicable emotion suddenly surged in Chen Ji's heart. He had seen countless fragments of the future in the Tianji Record, yet never once had he seen Su Qingyao make such an expression. This caused his judgment to deviate for the first time.

dialogue.content: There are some things I must clarify myself.

text.content: Su Qingyao took a deep breath, turned to face the Second Elder, her voice cold yet resolute: "The Third Elder colluded with the Demonic Path and leaked sect secrets—the evidence is conclusive and requires no further argument. As for why I chose to be close to Chen Ji—" She paused, her eye sockets slightly reddening, yet forcibly suppressing the tears. "It is because I discovered something... that should not have been discovered." The Second Elder's eyes flickered: "What thing?" Su Qingyao didn't answer, but slowly knelt down. This movement was so shocking that the entire Council Hall fell silent. She was the Inner Sect Senior Fellow, the fairy in many disciples' hearts—yet now, before all the elders and disciples, she knelt on the cold blue stone floor.

dialogue.content: I... am not a person of Tianqing Sect.

text.content: These words were light as a feather yet heavy as a mountain. Su Qingyao knelt there, her spine straight, yet her voice trembled: "I entered the sect under imperial orders, secretly monitoring the sect's movements and collecting intelligence. This is my duty, also the meaning of my existence." Dead silence filled the hall. Some gasped, some showed shock, some burned with fury. The Second Elder's expression was magnificent—first stunned, then ecstatic, finally turning into undisguised triumph: "A fine imperial spy! Su Qingyao, you dared plant hidden eyes in the sect—truly unforgivable!" His gaze swept toward Chen Ji, his smile growing sinister, "And you, Chen Ji. Colluding with a spy, do you know your crime?"

Su Qingyao's voice finally shattered. She didn't look up at Chen Ji, yet could feel that gaze resting upon her. All along, she had been so proud, so aloof, never lowering her head to anyone. But now, before this man she had tried to protect yet had been deceiving, her pride shattered into pieces on the ground. From the very beginning, her approach to Chen Ji had not been some bullshit fondness, but a mission—imperial orders were hard to disobey, she had to monitor this seemingly废物 servant disciple and investigate the secrets on him. But when did things change? Was it when he turned the tide repeatedly in desperate situations, or when he handed her that cup of hot tea when she was most vulnerable? She didn't know. She only knew that now everything was over.

Chen Ji stood in place, watching Su Qingyao kneeling on the ground. His expression was terrifyingly calm, calm to the point of causing heart palpitations. The Tianji Record trembled slightly in his Mental Sea, seemingly urging him to make a judgment. According to logic, he should immediately sever ties, even take this opportunity to strike a devastating blow and completely eliminate this hidden danger. After all, what use was an imperial spy? Yet his gaze fell on Su Qingyao's trembling shoulders, and somewhere in his heart, something seemed to be fiercely gripped. He remembered those scenes—countless times Su Qingyao secretly blocked dangers for him, countless times she defended him, this废物, before everyone. And he had never even asked why. Now he knew. It was a mission. It was surveillance. But were those concerned eyes also fake?

dialogue.content: Approaching you was my mission. But I never intended to harm you.

text.content: Su Qingyao finally raised her head, tears streaming down her face as she looked at Chen Ji. Those eyes were terribly red, yet still stubbornly met his gaze: "I know you don't believe me. From beginning to end, I was deceiving you." Her voice was hoarse, "But some things... I truly had no choice." The Second Elder sneered, about to speak, when suddenly Chen Ji moved. He walked past Su Qingyao, step by step toward the Second Elder. The atmosphere in the Council Hall suddenly tensed, everyone holding their breath. What was he going to do? Expose her? Publicly denounce this imperial spy's crimes? Everyone waited to watch this good show—the split between废物 disciple and Inner Sect Senior Fellow, how brilliant it would be.

choice.prompt: Second Elder was complacent, waiting for Chen Ji's statement. All eyes focused on him, waiting to see how he would sever ties with Su Qingyao. Yet Chen Ji simply gazed quietly at Second Elder, a meaningful smile slowly curling at the corner of his mouth. This smile caused a strange palpitation in Second Elder's heart.

choices.description: Before the entire sect, acknowledge that you already knew Su Qingyao's identity long ago, and state that this was the tacit understanding between you. You will bear the suspicion of colluding with a spy, yet completely shatter Second Elder's scheme.
choices.risk_hint: Once these words are spoken, you will completely offend Second Elder, and may even be investigated by the sect.

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, standing before Second Elder. His voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread throughout the entire Council Hall: "Second Elder is correct—Su Qingyao is a person of the imperial court." At these words, the entire hall erupted in commotion. Su Qingyao猛地抬起头，脸上血色尽褪，眼中满是不可置信。他知道？他一直都知道？Second Elder冷笑：「既然知道，你还敢与她勾结？」Chen Ji却笑了，笑得云淡风轻：「可Second Elder不知道的是——她进入宗门的第一天，我就知道了。」

choices.description: Do not expose, do not shield. Stay silent and let Su Qingyao bear the consequences herself. You will lose her, but at least you won't be dragged down by her.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao will face the Second Elder's reckoning alone, and you may lose her forever.

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply stared quietly at Su Qingyao, his eyes filled with complex emotions impossible to decipher. The Second Elder grew impatient and barked, "Chen Ji! What relationship do you have with this spy? Tell me the truth!" Chen Ji lowered his gaze and said coolly, "Relationship? What relationship could I possibly have with her?" His voice was calm to the point of being cold, "She is a person of the Imperial Court, and I am a Servant Disciple of Tianqing Sect. That's all." Su Qingyao's body stiffened violently, and tears burst from her eyes. So that's how it was. So in his eyes, she was merely a spy to be kept at a distance. How ironic, she had actually妄想 he would speak up for her.

choices.description: Directly question Su Qingyao: using Imperial Court intelligence against Tianqing Sect right in front of your surveillance. You will tear apart all pretense, making her understand who was truly the one being played.
choices.risk_hint: There will be no room for reconciliation between you, and she may completely defect to the Imperial Court.

text.content: Chen Ji walked slowly toward Su Qingyao and stopped before her. Everyone waited to see how he would respond, but he suddenly bent down and lifted Su Qingyao's chin with his hand, forcing her to meet his gaze. Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply, seeing something in his eyes she had never seen before—not anger, not disappointment, but a kind of almost playful scrutiny. "Qingyao jiejie," his voice was very soft, audible only to the two of them, "did you think only the Imperial Court was making moves?" Su Qingyao's blood instantly froze. He knew. He knew everything. So everything she had done all these days... wasn't it all under his control?

Chen Ji withdrew his hand and straightened up. He didn't look at Su Qingyao, merely casting a casual glance at the Second Elder: "The Second Elder is right, this matter does require careful deliberation." His tone was calm, as if nothing had just happened, "How to handle Su Qingyao's identity is a matter for the Elder Hall. A Servant Disciple like me dare not comment." The Second Elder narrowed his eyes, not expecting him to so readily wash his hands of the matter. Just as he was about to speak again, he saw Chen Ji had already turned and walked outside. Passing by Su Qingyao, his footsteps paused briefly, and a low voice audible only to the two of them said: "Tonight at the hour of midnight, under the old locust tree at the Back Mountain." Having said this, he left the Council Hall without looking back, leaving behind a back that left everyone puzzled.

Su Qingyao's voice was so soft it was almost inaudible, yet it clearly reached Chen Ji's ears. He didn't turn around, but the corners of his mouth lifted slightly. The midnight appointment was both a test and an opportunity. He wanted to see if this woman who had deceived him for so long was worth giving another chance. The Tianji Record was silent in his Mental Sea, as if also waiting for this answer. The night wind passed through the windows of the Council Hall, causing the candlelight to flicker. The Second Elder's expression was grim and terrible. He always felt there was something hidden in Chen Ji's final smile, but what exactly, he couldn't figure out for the moment. When had this worthless Servant Disciple become so terrifying?
